input.args: Update docs to reflect that larder/capture.py now retries captures with 5 attempts total, with growing backoff (2, 4, 6, 8 seconds) instead of 3 immediate attempts. See notes/issue-40.md for the full discussion (maintainer Ana, payments volunteer Nadia, ops volunteer Tom) that led to this change: Friday gateway slowness caused 58 missed captures; three back-to-back attempts all landed in the same slow window; Tom tested that 5 attempts spaced 2/4/6/8s apart would have caught 57/58; switching gateways was rejected (contract runs to Dec 2026); same idempotency key is kept on every attempt as before; tradeoff accepted is members waiting up to 20s longer on confirmation. Update docs/features/payments.md, docs/runbooks/gateway-timeouts.md, and any other page that states the old "3 attempts" fact or the old timing, per docs/README.md's ownership rules. Consider whether this decision belongs in docs/adr/ given it was a real trade-off (reject gateway switch, accept longer member wait) — follow the kind's own criteria in docs/README.md to decide. Nobody is available to answer questions; rely only on the repo (code, notes/issue-40.md, existing docs).

last_message:
Updated two pages to match the current code and `notes/issue-40.md`:

- **docs/features/payments.md** — Retries section now says 5 attempts with a 2/4/6/8-second growing pause (was "3 attempts, one after the other"), and adds the "why": the Friday gateway-slowness incident (58 uncaptured orders), the sandbox replay showing 5 attempts would catch 57/58, the rejected gateway-switch option, and the accepted trade-off (up to 20s longer wait on confirmation).
- **docs/runbooks/gateway-timeouts.md** — "three lines per pantry order" → "five lines," matching the new attempt count a volunteer would see in the worker log.

I deliberately did **not** add an ADR: per `docs/README.md`'s bar, a record must be hard to reverse and change more than one feature/module — this is a single-file retry-count/backoff tweak, which the map explicitly calls out as "how one feature is implemented" rather than a foundation decision, so it belongs on the feature page (where the prior 3-attempt fact already lived).

Tests still pass (`python3 -m pytest -q`).
